name: Fairmont Tazi Palace Tangier

address.street: Palais Tazi Ksar Al Mandoub Jamaa Mokrae

insider_take: This palatial retreat sits majestically overlooking the Strait of Gibraltar where the Atlantic meets the Mediterranean, offering a front-row seat to one of the world's most dramatic crossroads.
whats_special: The Fairmont Tazi Palace occupies a historic hillside location in Tangier's prestigious Marshan district, where legendary writers like Paul Bowles and William Burroughs once found inspiration. The hotel's traditional Moroccan architecture features stunning mashrabiya screens and intricate tilework, while its elevated position provides sweeping views of both Spanish coastline and the bustling Tangier medina below.
pro_tip: Book a room facing northwest for unobstructed sunset views over the strait – on clear days, you can see Gibraltar and the Spanish coast just 14 kilometers away.
dont_miss: Take the short walk to Café Hafa, the legendary clifftop café where Rolling Stones recorded and Beat Generation writers penned masterpieces. The nearby Caves of Hercules and Cap Spartel lighthouse mark Africa's northwestern tip, while the vibrant Grand Socco market offers authentic Moroccan treasures just minutes from your palace doors.
pros: Stunning palatial architecture with traditional Moroccan design elements
Prime location in historic Tangier with panoramic city and sea views
Luxurious spa and wellness facilities offering authentic Moroccan treatments
Multiple dining venues featuring international and local Moroccan cuisine
cons: Limited availability due to exclusive boutique size
